newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine to privatise businesses on OTC market - Fund.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine to privatise businesses on OTC market - Fund.

text.p: Ukraine's State Property Fund (FDM) plans to sell shares of privatised enterprises on the over-the-counter PFTS equities trading system in September or October, a fund official said on Tuesday.
Yuri Yakovlev, head of the state privatisation agency's stock exchange department, said the move faced difficulties.
He told Reuters previously the largest problem was setting share prices, since under Ukrainian law primary sales of shares cannot take place at lower than nominal prices.
The Kiev-based OTC market accounts for 80 percent of primary and about 20 percent of secondary market activity on Ukraine's embryonic stock exchange system.

The fund said previously it would sell on the OTC shares of businesses which already have stock market quotations and those with share packages which were not sold under the regular privatisation process.

Currently the fund sells shares of businesses undergoing privatisation on the Ukrainian Stock Exchange, which has 29 affiliates, the Ukrainian Interbank Currency Exchange, the Kiev International Stock Exchange and the Donetsk Stock Exchange.
